L114 says the HTTP proxy runs by default as one actor on the head node, while L575 says 'EveryNode(기본값)'; the two docs pages differ and the post states both without reconciling them.
Positive: one running example (text_ml:app, Summarizer -> Translator) threads through every section; back-references ('앞서 설명한 대로', L256, L316, L603) are accurate.

Slight over-explanation of easy material: framework-agnostic and three-step bind/serve.run repeated (L13 vs L25 and L47); serve build output description partly padded (L539).

ASCII diagrams labelled as illustrative (L118, L260); the official architecture image is not used, which would help at L102.

Those values are from the develop-and-deploy page's 'serve build model:translator_app' output; the config page's text_ml output has 'name: default', 'num_replicas: 1' and no ray_actor_options.

Wrong (L707): '디플로이먼트 상태는 HEALTHY, UNHEALTHY, UPDATING 중 하나입니다' — the Serve monitoring docs list six deployment statuses (also DEPLOY_FAILED, UPSCALING, DOWNSCALING); the application list adds DELETING, which the monitoring page's four-status list does not include (only the metrics enum does).
Default-proxy contradiction L114 vs L575 (docs-inherited, not reconciled).
